items.raw_excerpt: A 71-year-old homeless man in central China who spent 21 years collecting scrap to survive has received more than 420,000 yuan (US$63,000) in pension payments he did not know he was owed.
items.summary_en: A 71-year-old homeless man in central China spent 21 years collecting scrap to survive. He did not know he had over 420,000 yuan (US$63,000) in pension payments waiting in his account. Officials helped him claim the money.
items.summary_ko: 중국 중부 지역의 71세 노숙 남성이 생계를 위해 21년 동안 고물을 모으며 살았다. 그는 자신의 계좌에 42만 위안(약 6만 3천 달러)이 넘는 연금이 쌓여 있는 줄 몰랐다. 당국이 그가 연금을 받을 수 있도록 도왔다.
items.title_en: Homeless man in China collects scrap for 21 years, unaware of $63,000 pension
items.title_ko: 중국 노숙 남성, 21년간 고물을 모으며 6만 3천 달러 연금이 있는 줄 몰랐다
items.title_original: Homeless man scavenges for 21 years unaware of $63,000 pension sitting in his account

items.raw_excerpt: El informe reconoce falencias en el diseño del proyecto, pero no en el trabajo realizado por la Constructora San Sebastián. Desde el Minvu rechazaron estas conclusiones y reafirmaron su intención de entregar las mejores viviendas posibles.
items.summary_en: An inspection in El Olivar found problems in the project design, but not in the work done by Constructora San Sebastián. The housing ministry rejected these findings. Officials said they still plan to deliver the best possible homes.
items.summary_ko: 엘 올리바르의 한 점검에서 문제는 프로젝트 설계에 있었고 산 세바스티안 건설의 시공에는 없었다고 밝혔습니다. 주택부는 이 결론을 받아들이지 않았습니다. 당국은 여전히 최선의 주택을 공급하겠다고 밝혔습니다.
items.title_en: El Olivar: Inspection clears housing construction of defects

items.title_original: El Olivar: Peritaje descartó defectos en construcción de viviendas

items.raw_excerpt: Using old washing machine tubs and the bottoms of wheelie bins as flower beds, a small-scale, circular economy is thriving in the West MacDonnell Ranges, 200 kilometres west of Alice Springs.
items.summary_en: A remote community in Australia turns old washing machine tubs and wheelie bin bottoms into flower beds. This small circular economy grows food and teaches local kids how to garden. The effort sits 200 kilometres west of Alice Springs.

items.title_en: Costa the Garden Gnome plants seedlings in Utju

items.raw_excerpt: Papua New Guinea has committed around US$5.5 million (K$25m) to Tuvalu over five years in aid of its coastal reclamation efforts.
items.summary_en: Papua New Guinea will give Tuvalu about US$5.5 million over five years. The money will help Tuvalu rebuild its coast. The pledge came at a climate meeting held before COP.

items.raw_excerpt: Women are unable to give birth at a new birthing suite in northern New South Wales as the sector struggles with a nationwide shortage of GP obstetricians in regional areas.
items.summary_en: A new birthing suite in northern New South Wales is not being used. The hospital cannot find enough GP obstetricians, and regional areas nationwide face a shortage. So women cannot give birth there for now.

items.title_en: New birthing suite in New South Wales stays empty

items.raw_excerpt: Nunavut MP Lori Idlout announced a $77-million federal investment for the construction of the project first announced in 2019 and initially expected to be completed by 2025. Last week’s announcement is part of a $106-million commitment the government made in 2024.
items.summary_en: Arctic Bay in Nunavut will get a small craft harbour. The project was first announced in 2019. Canada has now promised $77 million for it, and it is expected to open in 2030.
items.summary_ko: 누나부트주 아크틱베이에 소형 선박 항구가 들어선다. 이 사업은 2019년에 처음 발표되었다. 캐나다 정부가 이번에 7700만 달러를 약속했고, 2030년에 문을 열 것으로 보인다.
items.title_en: Arctic Bay to get a small boat harbour by 2030
items.title_ko: 누나부트주 아크틱베이, 2030년까지 소형 선박 항구 생긴다
items.title_original: Long-awaited small craft harbour in Arctic Bay, Nunavut, expected to open in 2030

items.raw_excerpt: Pubs have been at the heart of village life for centuries, but as drinking habits changed some have closed and others have had to adapt and expand ...
items.summary_en: A village pub in Yorkshire called The Black Lion has grown beyond just serving drinks. It now runs allotments, a cafe, clubs, a shop and a caravan site. The pub changed to keep up with new drinking habits.

items.title_en: Yorkshire Village Pub Adds Allotments, Cafe and Caravan Site

items.raw_excerpt: Lionel Messi gives Argentina fans one last moment of joy as he signs off with his 126th international goal in his final cap for the nation.
items.summary_en: Lionel Messi played his last match for Argentina. He scored his 126th international goal and gave fans one more happy moment. It was an emotional goodbye for the star player.

items.raw_excerpt: Drone footage showed the village of Peacham, Vermont, filled with vibrant fall foliage on Saturday, October 3. Captured by John Rowe Photos, the footage shows hues of red, orange, and yellow illuminat...
items.summary_en: Drone video shows Peacham, Vermont, glowing with red, orange, and yellow leaves on October 3. The small village is known for its bright autumn views. The footage was captured by John Rowe Photos.
